brief: Towerless Gothic Revival 'hall church' in red brick, two tall storeys on a sloping street: a gable front with corner buttress-piers capped by white pinnacles, a round-arched tracery window over the arched double white doors, and a corbelled brick band under the raking cornice. The long side has two tiers of round-arched windows (lower hall, upper sanctuary) between pilasters, a stone belt course and a dark slate-grey roof. Glass-fronted notice board and a lamp post by the steps.
